Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: Strong orchestration signals detected (debugging/root-cause, multi-surface scope, parallelizable uncertainty, runtime/performance/concurrency).

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: map API, worker, and database timeout paths and return likely boundaries
- independent track 2: identify intermittent-timeout reproduction and targeted verification commands
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_mapper
  mode: read-only
  scope: API, worker, and database timeout paths
  expected output: boundaries, facts, uncertainty
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: intermittent timeout reproduction
  expected output: targeted commands and gaps
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
